title: Batches and epochs
summary: A batch is a small group of examples processed together. An epoch is one pass through the training set. More passes do not guarantee a better test result.
introduction: A batch is a small group of examples processed together. An epoch is one pass through the training set. More passes do not guarantee a better test result. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A batch is a small group of examples processed together. An epoch is one pass through the training set. More passes do not guarantee a better test result.

blocks.code:
Training set: 12 examples
Batch size: 4 examples
One epoch: 3 batches
Two epochs: 6 batches in total
blocks.title: Batches and epochs

blocks.text: Twelve divided by four makes three batches per pass. Two passes make six batch visits. Each pass uses the same training examples again.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Work out batches per epoch for 20 examples and batch size 5.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not count an epoch as a new set of data.
For more detail later, use this [Deep Learning further reading](https://d2l.ai/chapter_introduction/index.html).
